'''Developer Products'''
---- {{For|other uses of [[Dev (Disambiguation)|Dev]]}}
'''Developer Products''' can be purchased with {{Robux|Robux}}. '''Developer Products''' have various utilities, gifting other players gamepasses, skipping ranks in the Battle Passes, or making your progression easier by buying coins or gems. '''Developer Products''' also occasionally have [[Sales]], which temporarily reduce their costs for a specific occasion, or bring back currently unavailable '''Developer Products''' for a limited time.
==Price Changes== The costs listed here and the ones seen by the player on the Roblox site or the game itself may not be the same. This is due to the wiki listing the the base value of the price, which may not be the value used for certain players. This can happen for two reasons, either price optimization or regional pricing. ===Regional Pricing=== ''This is a brief overview of the Roblox feature. For more information, go [https://create.roblox.com/docs/production/monetization/regional-pricing here]. Certain '''Developer Products''' in Tower Defense Simulator have regional pricing applies to them. This will change the cost of the gamepass based on the player's region. If Roblox is unable to accurately determine the player's country, the base value is used instead. The cost of the '''Developer Product''' will never go below 30% of the cost. ===Price Optimization=== ''This is a brief overview of the Roblox feature. For more information, go [https://create.roblox.com/docs/production/monetization/price-optimization here]. Tower Defense Simulator uses price optimization some time after '''Developer Products''' and developer products are released. This means that subsets of players will receive different prices, generally varying from a 25% increase to a 25% decrease. This is not based on location, for example, two people in the same country can have different prices, one a 10% increase and the other a 25% decrease. After the price optimization test ends, the best prices are applied globally to the '''Developer Products'''. ==Developer Products== {{Tabber |General Developer Products |{{/General}} |Cosmetics Developer Products |{{/Cosmetics}} |Passes Developer Products |{{/Passes}} |Unused Developer Products |{{/Unused}} }} ==Notes== {{scroll|text = }} {{BrowseNavBox}} [[Category:Miscellaneous]]
